about: The Yaoki Library: original works written for Yaoki. The reader lists them under 'From the Yaoki Library'. Each work lists its parts in reading order; each part is a UTF-8 text file in this folder, at most 30,000 characters. Newest works first. How to add one: README.md, 'The Yaoki Library'.

works.title: 始末書
works.about: A clerk at a railway's lost-property office writes a letter of apology nobody asked for, about a one-eyed daruma left on the last train. A novella told entirely in workplace keigo.

parts.title: 始末書　下　追記
